title: Grade 2 Math — Fri, Jun 05
description: 3D Solid Shapes — Day 5 of 5: Synthesis — name, count, sort
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Which solid has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 corners?
questions.explanation: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 corners.

questions.question: Which solid has 0 faces, 0 edges and 0 corners?
questions.explanation: A sphere is smooth all over with no faces, edges or corners.

questions.question: Riya has a ball, a dice and a tin can. How many can roll?
questions.explanation: The ball and the tin can roll; the dice (cube) does not. So 2.

questions.question: Which solid has 1 flat face and 1 pointy corner?
questions.explanation: A cone has 1 flat round face and 1 vertex at the tip.

questions.question: Count the flat faces: cylinder + cube = ?
questions.explanation: Cylinder has 2 flat faces, cube has 6. 2 + 6 = 8.

questions.question: Which solid is best for making a tall, steady tower?
questions.explanation: Flat faces all around make the cube easy to stack steadily.

questions.question: A solid with 2 flat round faces and a curved side is a ___.
questions.explanation: Two flat round ends plus a curved side describe a cylinder.

questions.question: Which group can ALL roll?
questions.explanation: Ball, orange and marble are all spheres — they all roll.

questions.question: How many corners does a cuboid have?
questions.explanation: Like a cube, a cuboid has 8 corners.

questions.question: An ice-cream cone and a party hat share which shape?
questions.explanation: Both are cones — wide base, pointy top.

questions.question: Which solid has the most edges?
questions.explanation: A cube has 12 straight edges — the most among these.

questions.question: Which does NOT belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Cube, cuboid and matchbox are box-like with flat faces; the sphere is round.

questions.question: A shape that slides but never rolls must have ___.
questions.explanation: Only flat faces means no curved part to roll on — it slides.

questions.question: Which solid matches a globe of the Earth?
questions.explanation: A globe is round all over — a sphere.

questions.question: Sort by faces: which has exactly 1 flat face?
questions.explanation: A cone has exactly 1 flat face (its round base).
